batch: OLP-0182–0190 Model Theory Basics under the cumulative Model Theory profile
method: Fresh comparison of every exact frozen-English and Gujarati linguistic block, with independently worded reverse paraphrases for every substantive block. The review covers reducts, substructures, compactness overspill, isomorphism, theories of structures, partial isomorphisms, bounded quantifier rank, dense linear orders and all eight adjacent disclosed source repairs. One rejected candidate was checked against the upstream macro declaration and preserved.
